description: This file defines a specialized vectorized double class for VSX architecture, including vector operations, blending, mathematical functions, and comparisons, used for high-performance computations in the ATen library.

classes.name: Vectorized<double>
classes.description: A vector class for double precision floating point numbers optimized for VSX architecture, supporting various mathematical and logical operations.

methods.name: zero_mask
methods.description: Returns a mask indicating zero elements in the vector.

methods.name: blend
methods.description: Selects elements from two vectors based on a compile-time mask.

methods.name: blendv
methods.description: Blend two vectors based on a runtime mask.

methods.name: arange
methods.description: Creates a vector with a range of values starting from a base, with a specified step.

methods.name: loadu
methods.description: Loads data from memory into a vector, with support for partial loads.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores vector data into memory, supporting partial stores.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the element-wise absolute value.

methods.name: acos
methods.description: Returns the element-wise arc cosine.

methods.name: acosh
methods.description: Returns the element-wise inverse hyperbolic cosine.

methods.name: asin
methods.description: Returns the element-wise arc sine.

methods.name: asinh
methods.description: Returns the element-wise inverse hyperbolic sine.

methods.name: atan
methods.description: Returns the element-wise arc tangent.

methods.name: atanh
methods.description: Returns the element-wise inverse hyperbolic tangent.

methods.name: atan2
methods.description: Computes the element-wise arc tangent of y/x considering the signs.

methods.name: copysign
methods.description: Returns a vector with the magnitude of the first and the sign of the second.

methods.name: erf
methods.description: Returns the element-wise error function.

methods.name: erfc
methods.description: Returns the element-wise complementary error function.

methods.name: exp
methods.description: Returns the element-wise exponential.

methods.name: exp2
methods.description: Returns 2 raised to the power of each element.

methods.name: expm1
methods.description: Returns exp(x)-1 element-wise.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of each element.

methods.name: log10
methods.description: Returns the base-10 logarithm of each element.

methods.name: log1p
methods.description: Returns log(1 + x) element-wise.

methods.name: log2
methods.description: Returns the base-2 logarithm of each element.

methods.name: ceil
methods.description: Returns the smallest integer not less than each element.

methods.name: cos
methods.description: Returns the element-wise cosine.

methods.name: cosh
methods.description: Returns the element-wise hyperbolic cosine.

methods.name: floor
methods.description: Returns the largest integer not greater than each element.

methods.name: neg
methods.description: Returns the element-wise negation.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds each element to the nearest integer.

methods.name: sin
methods.description: Returns the element-wise sine.

methods.name: sinh
methods.description: Returns the element-wise hyperbolic sine.

methods.name: tan
methods.description: Returns the element-wise tangent.

methods.name: tanh
methods.description: Returns the element-wise hyperbolic tangent.

methods.name: trunc
methods.description: Returns the integer part of each element.

methods.name: frac
methods.description: Returns the fractional part of each element.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description: Returns the element-wise square root.

methods.name: reciprocal
methods.description: Returns the element-wise reciprocal.

methods.name: rsqrt
methods.description: Returns the element-wise reciprocal of the square root.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises each element to the power of corresponding element in b.

methods.name: fmod
methods.description: Returns the element-wise floating-point remainder.

methods.name: hypot
methods.description: Returns the element-wise hypotenuse.

methods.name: nextafter
methods.description: Returns the next representable value after each element towards b.

methods.name: igamma
methods.description: Computes the incomplete gamma function.

methods.name: igammac
methods.description: Computes the complemented incomplete gamma function.

methods.name: i0
methods.description: Modified Bessel function of the first kind, order zero.

methods.name: i0e
methods.description: Exponential decay of i0.

methods.name: digamma
methods.description: Digamma function.
